data.title: Notice of increased working hours and salary from Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH
data.summary: Beispielsoft Solutions GmbH (People & Culture) informs Harriet Collins that her weekly working hours will rise from 32 to 40 from 1 January 2027, with salary adjusted accordingly, and asks her to sign and return the enclosed contract amendment by 11 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your employer is increasing your contracted weekly hours from 32 to 40 starting 1 January 2027, with a corresponding salary increase. To confirm the change, sign both copies of the enclosed amendment and send one back to People & Culture by the stated date so payroll can apply it in January. If you have concerns about the new hours or pay, raise them with People & Culture before signing; if you disagree, you may want to clarify this in writing or seek advice before returning the signed copy.
